region.note: predict a probability map over exactly this 4096x4096 level-2 region

ground_truth.origin: 2023 Grand-Prize-era human ink annotation (villa ink-detection train_scrolls inklabels) registered onto the re-flattened SOTA geometry

revision.reason: The prior label was produced with a hardcoded LEVEL0_SHAPE belonging to segment 20230702185753 (50600x36400). This segment's level-0 surface volume is 51000x39980, so the level-2 region crop was scaled wrongly in register_run.py::_region_in_mesh -- both the crop origin and the crop width -- emitting a label that was displaced AND stretched (x +9.8%, y +0.79%). Agreement with the canon prediction peaked ~1766 level-0 voxels away from zero shift instead of at it. That artifact produced the retracted claim that all published models read this segment at chance.
revision.fix: LEVEL0_SHAPES is now a per-segment dict; _set_target() raises for any segment without a recorded shape rather than falling back to a default. Verified against the bucket via `register_run.py verify_shapes`.
revision.credit: The misalignment was surfaced by erdpx when closing villa PR #1280 (https://github.com/ScrollPrize/villa/pull/1280).

registration.method: obj-exact: original.obj vt (427091 vertices), NN bridge via on-7.91um tifxyz (same old-scan frame), vt convention rowHv_colu

gate.note: Enrichment is reported as a diagnostic, but it is now DECISIVE (6.01 vs 1.77/1.84/1.61) and would clear a teacher-dependent gate too. On the pre-fix label it read 1.68 and failed that gate -- which we wrongly attributed to a weak teacher and worked around with this teacher-free gate. The gate was correct; the registration was broken.

registration.caveat: Placement is gated (must peak within 48 level-2 px of zero shift); this target measures 32.0 px. The ~8-voxel median residual measures correspondence SCATTER, not absolute placement -- conflating the two is what hid the original bug. Use the placement figure, not the residual.

placement.note: Agreement with the canon prediction peaks 32 level-2 px off zero. This is the target's RESOLUTION LIMIT, not a pending bug: original.obj carries the 2023 label mapping in the old 7.91um scan frame, and the 2023/2026 segmentations of this sheet are materially different surfaces (unpaired 3D similarity leaves p50 64 / p90 249 old-scan voxels). Two candidate fixes tested and falsified. Features closer than ~0.31mm cannot be scored reliably; all scores are mild lower bounds.

role: HELD-OUT flagship target: no public model we know of was trained on this segment.
